item.name: Creates a new chart of account segment

request.name: Creates a new chart of account segment

description.content: Creates a new chart of account segment in AppZen and returns a uuid that uniquely identifies it. When there already exists a chart of account segment (segment_code), then the operation is an update (the `status` would be `UPDATED` in this case).

header.description: Flag to indicate whether the segment-name should be used to determine (in addition to segment-code and segment-type) whether the payload signifies a unique chart of account
Flag to indicate whether the segment-lookup-names list in the payload should be concatenated to the corresponding list in an existing chart of account
